UNKNOWN means report unknown, not failure. Never pick using a robot-health revision as a substitute for an UNKNOWN object pose. After an accepted pick is verified with nothing held, stop and report failure; do not repeat it. In every non-battery task, submit_report battery_percent MUST be the literal integer -1, even when observe_robot returned a real battery percentage. Do not call tools after submit_report.
---
